subject: Trading
title: Jim Simons: The Mathematician Who Beat Markets
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Jim Simons: The Mathematician Who Beat Markets.

hook.text: Jim Simons' Medallion Fund returned 66% annually before fees for over 30 years. No human trader comes close.

buildup.text: Simons was a code-breaker and math professor who founded Renaissance Technologies in 1982.

discovery.text: He hired physicists and mathematicians—never finance people—to find hidden patterns in massive data sets.

twist.text: Medallion is closed to outside investors. Only employees can invest. The returns are too good to share.

climax.text: Simons proved that quantitative methods can find signals invisible to human traders—if you have the right minds.

punchline.text: The best trader in history never read a balance sheet.

quiz.question: What made Jim Simons' approach to trading unique?
options: He hired mathematicians and physicists to find patterns in data
